clips.title: The story
paras: In Duskwood, Eliza's buried corpse holds a heart that still beats. The Embalmer placed his own heart in his dead wife through dark magic, and it became the anchor of his power.

Darkshire's tales remember the Embalmer as a gentle alchemist. When his wife Eliza died, grief shattered his mind. He turned to foul sorcery, cut out his own heart, and placed it in her lifeless chest. The magic stirred her corpse to unlife, but the return twisted Eliza into a ravenous creature with an insatiable hunger for living human flesh. Horrified by what he had done, the alchemist buried her again.
